description.zh: 测你更像哪位《赛博朋克：边缘行者》角色。完成21道情境选择，在大卫、露西、丽贝卡等七位初代动画角色中找出匹配结果。免费，无需注册。

title.zh: Caliper风格评估：最符合／最不符合练习

description.en: Practise Most/Least choices in 16 original four-statement blocks. See eight topics with both counts, their differences and complete free guides. Independent format practice, no signup.
description.zh: 用16组原创四陈述题块练习最符合／最不符合选择，免费查看八主题两类次数、差值与完整读法。独立题式练习，无需注册。

description.en: Explore social camouflaging with the original 25-item CAT-Q. View raw sums, three separate parts and complete free explanations. Adult self-reflection, no signup or diagnostic cutoff.
description.zh: 通过原始25项CAT-Q回看社交伪装体验，免费查看原始合计、三个部分及完整解释。供成年人自我反思，无需注册，不设诊断切点。

description.en: Explore achievement-related self-doubt through twenty original prompts about contribution, feedback, evaluation, comparison and preparation. Free separate frequency readings and five complete guides, with no signup.
description.zh: 通过二十条原创题目，回看贡献、反馈、评价、比较与准备中的成就相关自我怀疑。免费查看分别呈现的频率读数与五篇完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Explore voluntary visual imagery with twelve original prompts about objects, fictional faces, places and pictured movement. Free separate readings and four complete guides, without signup.
description.zh: 通过物体、虚构面孔、地点与运动画面十二个原创情境，观察主动视觉意象。免费查看四组分别呈现的读数与完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Recall fifteen descriptions involving symbols, colours, sounds, spatial sequences, personification and taste or touch-like impressions. Free literal response records and five complete guides, without signup.
description.zh: 回顾涉及符号、颜色、声音、空间序列、人格化及味道或触觉样印象的十五条描述。免费查看字面回答记录与五篇完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Describe sound-linked reactions and everyday impact using the DVMSQ v1.5: one screening question and up to eighteen source prompts. Free raw sums, response records and three complete guides, without signup.
description.zh: 通过DVMSQ v1.5回顾声音相关反应与日常影响：一个前置问题，最多十八条后续源题。免费查看原始合计、回答记录与三篇完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Explore noticing cues later, adding input, being interrupted and reducing input through sixteen original prompts. Free separate response readings and four complete guides for everyday and work situations, without signup.
description.zh: 通过十六条原创描述，分别回顾晚察觉、增加输入、被输入打断与减少输入。免费查看四组独立读数及日常与工作情境的完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Review anger occurring, outward expression, kept-inside feelings and perceived choice through twenty original prompts about the past four weeks. Free separate response records and four complete guides, without signup.
description.zh: 通过二十条原创描述，回顾过去四周的怒意出现、外显表达、保留感受与自感选择。免费查看四组独立记录与四篇完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Practise thirty-two original English questions in arithmetic reasoning, vocabulary, paragraph comprehension and mathematics. Choose timed or untimed study; review every answer, bilingual explanation and four complete guides free.
description.zh: 练习算术推理、英文词汇、段落理解与数学知识三十二道原创英文题。可选计时或不计时，免费查看全部答案、双语解析及四篇完整指南。

description.en: Reflect on explaining, inviting input, bounded decisions, shared agreements, support and handoffs through 24 original statements. Free separate means, response coverage and six complete guides for ordinary shared plans.
description.zh: 用24条原创陈述，回顾说明理由、邀请参与、职责内决定、共同约定、支持与交接。免费查看六组独立均分、有效项数及共同计划的完整指南。

description.en: Practise thirty original English questions in science, mechanical models, electric circuits, auto/shop knowledge and written assembly. Choose timed or untimed study; every bilingual solution and five complete guides are free.
description.zh: 练习普通科学、机械模型、电路、汽车车间与文字组装三十道原创英文题。可选计时或不计时，免费查看全部双语解答与五篇完整指南。

description.en: Reflect on invitations, coordination and personal warmth with 24 original items. Read six separate action and wish summaries, transparent scoring and complete free guides.
description.zh: 通过24条原创题回顾参与邀请、实际协调与个人关心，分别阅读六项行动和期望摘要、透明计分与完整免费指南。

description.en: Explore feeling important to others and feeling insignificant with the five-item GMS and five-item AMS. About 3 minutes; two separate 5–20 scores and complete guides, free without signup.
description.zh: 通过五题GMS与五题AMS，回顾被他人看重与感到无足轻重的体验。约3分钟，免费查看两项独立5至20分与完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Practise 18 original English passage, numerical and logical reasoning questions. Choose section timers or untimed study; review every answer and three complete free guides.
description.zh: 练习18道原创英文阅读、数量与逻辑推理题，可选分段计时或不计时学习，免费查看每题解析和三篇完整指南。

description.en: Reflect on four social topics with 24 original agreement statements. Read separate topic means, transparent scoring and four complete free guides, without a political or identity label.
description.zh: 通过24条原创认同陈述，回顾四个社会主题，分别查看主题均分、透明计分与四篇完整免费指南，不派发政治或身份标签。

description.en: Practise 30 original English questions across five critical-thinking families. Choose one continuous 30-minute clock or untimed study; review every explanation and five full guides free.
description.zh: 练习五类批判性思维的30道原创英文题，可选整卷30分钟连续计时或不计时学习，免费查看全部解析与五篇完整指南。

description.en: Complete the original ten English TIPI trait pairs with seven-point ratings. View five independent raw Big Five means and full free guides; Chinese is a declared working translation.
description.zh: 用七级认同评价TIPI十组英文原特质，免费查看五项独立大五原始均值与完整指南；中文为明确标注的工作译文。

title.zh: SBTI 娱乐人格测试：31题版

description.en: Answer 31 questions and see your playful SBTI portrait and 15 model readouts. Explore all 25 portrait guides for free, with no signup.
description.zh: 完成31道情境题，查看你的SBTI趣味画像与15项模型读数。25篇画像指南均可免费阅读，无需注册。

title.zh: 工作活动兴趣盘点：60项原创任务

description.en: Explore your interest in 60 concrete work tasks across six separate areas. See rated counts, means and six complete free guides. No signup; about 12 minutes.
description.zh: 用60项具体任务盘点动手、调查、创作、支持、推动与整理兴趣，分别查看有效项数、均分及六篇完整免费指南。约12分钟，无需注册。

description.en: Explore five intimacy priorities with 25 original importance ratings. Read separate means and five complete free guides, with room to leave items unscored.
description.zh: 用25条原创重要程度题，梳理隐私、轻松、稳定、信任与情感靠近。分别查看五项读数与完整免费指南，可保留未评分，无需注册。

description.en: Review 16 everyday relationship moments from your own side over three months. Explore space, fairness tallies, delayed talks and extra giving with four free guides.
description.zh: 用16条原创题回看过去三个月自己一侧的相处时刻，分别了解空间、心里记账、延后谈话与超出余量付出。四篇完整指南免费，无需注册。

description.en: Explore four current dating beliefs with sixteen original statements: connection possibilities, learnable skills, guarded expectations and fixed conditions. Read separate raw means, missing-answer coverage and four complete free guides.
description.zh: 用十六条原创陈述探索当前的联结可能、可学习技巧、保留期待与固定条件四类恋爱信念，分别查看原始均值、未评分覆盖及四篇免费完整指南。

title.zh: 工作角色与支持方式回顾

description.en: Review twelve task instances from one role over the past twelve weeks. Record responsibility and support across problem clarification, delivery checking and shared contribution; read all twelve records and three complete free guides.
description.zh: 回看一个角色近十二周的十二项任务实例，记录澄清问题、核对交付与共同贡献中的责任及支持情境，查看十二条所选记录与三篇免费完整指南。

description.en: Reflect on sixteen original prompts about your face self-image over the past month: face-view, chosen care, photo ease and attention around people. Read four separate frequency means and complete free guides; no photo or camera needed.
description.zh: 用十六条原创题回看过去一个月的面部看法、自主打理、照片自在感与人群中的注意体验，分别查看四项频率均值及免费完整指南，无需照片或相机。

description.en: Review sixteen original prompts about your own relationship-worry responses over the past three months. Read separate frequencies for repeated reassurance, comparison, extra giving for connection and indirect checks, with four complete free guides.
description.zh: 用十六条原创题回看过去三个月自己一侧的关系担心反应，分别阅读再次求安心、比较注意、为联结额外付出与间接试探的频率，以及四篇免费完整指南。

description.en: Review forty-two original work behaviors from the past four weeks. Read seven separate frequency summaries and complete guides covering pressure, initiative, follow-through, contact, consideration, agreements and learning. Free, without registration.
description.zh: 用四十二条原创行为题回看过去四周，分别阅读压力回应、主动行动、任务接续、发起联系、他人视角、履行约定与探索学习七组频率及完整指南。免费，无需注册。

description.en: Complete the published 28-item Short Dark Tetrad and read four separate seven-item means with full explanations. Original English, working Chinese translation, transparent scoring and no registration; no total or personality type.
description.zh: 完成发表版28题简式黑暗四特质量表，分别阅读四项七题均值与完整解释。保留英文原题，提供中文工作译文及透明计分；无需注册，不生成总分或人格类型。

description.en: Review fifteen original statements about romantic and sexual attraction over the past twelve months. Read five separate agreement means, scoring examples and five complete free guides, without an orientation or identity assignment.
description.zh: 用十五条原创陈述回看过去十二个月的浪漫与性吸引体验，分别阅读五项认同均值、计分示例与五篇免费完整指南，不分配取向或身份。

description.en: Practise six written coordination tasks: 32 entry cards and 30 English questions. Read separate counts, full explanations and six free bilingual guides.
description.zh: 练习六类书面协调任务：32张录入卡与30道英文题，分别查看计数、完整解析和六篇免费双语指南。

description.en: Reflect on 24 pairs of distributed-work actions: handover context, visible task state, answerable help requests and workable reply windows. View separate choice counts and four complete guides, free and without signup.
description.zh: 通过24组分布式协作行动配对，回顾交接背景、任务状态可见、可回答的求助请求与可行回复窗口。分别查看选择计数与四篇完整指南，免费、无需注册。

description.en: Explore your current preferences for long lines, room and ease, even balance, compact contrast and soft drape. Answer 15 original statements and read five separate results with complete free guides; no signup or photo needed.
description.zh: 通过15条原创陈述，回顾目前对连贯长线、舒展余量、平稳均衡、紧凑对照与柔和垂落的偏好。分别查看五项结果及完整免费指南，无需注册或照片。

title.zh: 困难经历后的反应回顾

description.en: An optional adult reflection on 20 observations from the past four weeks: reminders, distance, mood and connection, and feeling on edge. View separate category records and four complete free guides, without recounting the event.
description.zh: 通过20条观察，自愿回顾过去四周的提醒、距离、情绪联系与紧绷警觉。供成年人分别查看类别记录及四篇完整免费指南，无需讲述事件。

description.en: Explore eight whole-look styling themes through 16 original written comparisons of colour, outline, texture and detail. View all counts, every highest tie and eight complete free guides; no photo or signup.
description.zh: 通过16次原创文字比较，探索配色、轮廓、质感与细节的八种整体造型主题。免费查看全部次数、所有最高并列与八篇完整指南，无需照片或注册。

description.en: Reflect on 20 original statements about activity choices in the past four weeks. Read separate frequency means for starting, responding, changing interests, invited contribution and observation, with five complete free guides.
description.zh: 通过20条原创陈述回看过去四周的活动选择，分别阅读自主发起、回应机会、兴趣切换、受邀贡献与环境观察的频率均值，五篇完整指南免费开放。

description.en: An optional adult reflection on 12 observations from the past four weeks: protecting a position, moving away, getting stuck and agreeing early. Read separate category records and four complete free guides, without assigning a response type.
description.zh: 通过12条观察，自愿回顾过去四周维护立场、退开、回应卡住与先答应的日常行动。供成年人分别阅读类别记录与四篇完整免费指南，不分配反应类型。

title.zh: 灵魂伴侣测试：连接偏好

description.en: Explore six connection ideals through 12 original fictional comparisons. See every raw tally, all highest ties and six complete free guides, without signup or partner details.
description.zh: 通过12道原创想象情境比较六种连接偏好，查看全部原始次数、所有最高并列与六篇完整免费指南，无需注册或伴侣资料。

description.en: Review 21 original observations about unwanted distance, listening and belonging over the past four weeks. Read three complete free guides and keep separate category records privately in this page.
description.zh: 通过21条原创观察回顾过去四周不想要的疏远感、想要的倾听与归属体验。免费阅读三篇完整指南，在当前页面私下整理三个分别阅读的类别记录。

description.en: Review familiar surface outlines through 12 original descriptions. See three separate means and complete free guides, without photographs, measurements or a body-type assignment.
description.zh: 通过12条原创描述回顾已经熟悉的体表轮廓，查看三个独立均值与三篇完整免费指南，无需照片、测量或身体类型分配。

description.en: Use 18 original statements to review recent concerns, daily effects, support conditions and questions about professional care. Read your six-category records and four complete guides free, without signup.
description.zh: 通过18条原创陈述，回顾近期困扰、日常影响、支持条件与专业支持疑问。免费查看六类回答记录和四篇完整指南，无需注册。

description.en: Review your own experience in one adult connection through 15 original frequency prompts. Explore familiarity, similarities, pauses, understanding and meaning, with five separate readings and full guides free.
description.zh: 通过15条原创频率陈述，回顾自己在同一段成年连接中的熟悉感、相似处、放慢、理解与意义。免费查看五部分独立读数与完整指南。

title.zh: 重要的人去世之后：个人回顾

description.en: Use 16 original observations to review missing someone, changed roles, reminders, plans and support after a death. Read five private category records and five complete public guides free, with optional timing.
description.zh: 通过16条原创观察，回顾重要的人去世之后的想念、角色变化、提醒、计划与支持。免费查看五个主题的私人类别记录及完整公开指南，时间背景可不提供。

description.en: Read all 21 published BPI items with working Chinese, then view three mapped-choice counts and percentages when every item is scored. Explore Vata, Pitta and Kapha through three complete cultural guides, free without signup.
description.zh: 阅读完整21项发表BPI题文及工作中译；每题都计分时，查看三个关联选择计数与占比。通过Vata、Pitta、Kapha三篇完整文化指南认识传统词语，全部免费，无需注册。

description.en: Use 20 original observations to review settling to sleep, interruptions, earlier waking, daytime experiences and sleep concerns over the past two weeks. Read five private category records and five complete public guides free, without signup.
description.zh: 用20条原创观察回顾过去两周的入睡、睡眠中断、比计划早醒、白天经历及睡眠担忧。免费查看五个主题的私人类别记录与完整公开指南，无需注册。

description.en: Recall the past four weeks with 21 original observations about bodily attention, questions and serious possibilities. View private category records and three complete public guides, free and without signup.
description.zh: 通过21条原创观察，回顾过去四周对身体感觉的注意、提问与严重可能性方面的经历。免费查看私人类别记录与三篇完整公开指南，无需注册。

description.en: Explore seven story roles and five pasaran lenses through 35 original fictional choices. Read every highest-tied pairing in full, browse 35 free guides, or use the separate optional Javanese calendar reference.
description.zh: 通过35道原创虚构选择，探索七个故事角色与五个市日视角。完整阅读所有最高并列组合，免费浏览35篇指南，也可独立查看可选爪哇历法参考。

title.zh: 突然强烈恐惧：个人回顾

description.en: Reflect on 20 original descriptions of sudden fear, accompanying sensations and thoughts, anticipation, and changes to plans. Review four separate category records and four complete guides, free and without signup.
description.zh: 通过20条原创描述回顾突然恐惧、伴随的感觉与想法、担心再次出现，以及计划的变化。免费查看四组独立类别记录和四篇完整指南，无需注册。

title.en: Unwanted Thoughts & Repeated Actions: Personal Reflection
title.zh: 不想要的想法与重复动作：个人回顾

description.en: Explore 20 original observations about cleaning concerns, checking, repetition, unwanted thoughts and belongings. Review five separate category records and five complete guides, free and without signup.
description.zh: 通过20条原创观察回顾清洁担忧、再次查看、重复动作、不想要的想法及财物决定。免费查看五组独立类别记录与五篇完整指南，无需注册。

title.zh: 注意力与能量：日常情境回顾

description.en: Reflect on attention, restlessness, feelings and available energy, and uncertainty after social exchanges with 16 original observations. Review four separate category records and four complete guides, free and without signup.
description.zh: 用16条原创观察回顾活动中的注意、坐立不安、感受与可用精力，以及交流后的不确定。免费查看四组分别呈现的类别记录与四篇完整指南，无需注册。

title.zh: Nakshatra出生宿计算器：Spica参考口径

description.en: Calculate a Spica-reference birth star and pada from a known birth date, time and historical time zone. Inspect Moon longitudes, boundary comparisons and all 27 free cultural guides.
description.zh: 用已知出生日期、时间与历史时区，计算角宿一参考出生宿及四分区；查看月球黄经、边界对照与全部27篇免费文化指南。

title.zh: 阅读与书写：日常情境回顾

description.en: Recall 20 everyday reading and writing experiences over four weeks. Explore four separate category records and complete free guides on text, writing, unfamiliar words and access choices.
description.zh: 用20条原创观察回顾过去四周的阅读与书写经历，分别查看四个主题的类别记录，免费阅读书面内容、成文、陌生词语与接触信息方式的完整指南。

title.en: Numbers in Daily Life: Personal Reflection

description.en: Recall the past four weeks through 20 original observations about quantities, calculation steps, time, measures and prices. Read four complete guides and your category counts free, without registration.
description.zh: 通过20条原创观察，回顾过去四周的数量理解、计算步骤、时间度量与价格信息。免费阅读四篇完整指南与自己的类别计数，无需注册。

description.en: Recall the past four weeks through 20 original observations about being observed, conversations, social plans and sensations. Read four complete guides and your category counts free, without registration.
description.zh: 通过20条原创观察，回顾过去四周被他人看到、谈话联系、社交计划与身体感觉的经历。免费阅读四篇完整指南与自己的类别计数，无需注册。

title.zh: 照护与感受：回忆与当下

description.en: Explore 20 original descriptions of remembered emotional attention, responses and comfort, alongside feelings and support in the past four weeks. Four complete readings and private category records are free, without registration.
description.zh: 通过20条原创描述，分别整理记得的情绪关注、感受回应与安慰，以及过去四周的感受和支持。四篇完整读法与私人类别记录免费开放，无需注册。

description.en: Twenty original descriptions for adults to reflect on drinking plans, everyday effects, situations and bodily experiences over the past four weeks. Read four separate category records and all complete guides, free and without registration.
description.zh: 通过20条原创描述，回顾成年人过去四周的饮酒计划、生活影响、情境与身体感受。四组类别记录与完整读法免费开放，无需注册。

description.en: Reflect on recurring worries, tension and worry during ordinary activities with 12 original adult observations about the past four weeks. Read three separate category records and all complete guides free, without registration.
description.zh: 通过12条成年人原创观察，回顾过去四周反复担心、紧绷与日常活动中的经历。三个主题分别记录类别，完整读法免费开放，无需注册。

title.zh: 儿童专注与活动：照顾者观察
